items.item_text: Current California RN license

Current BLS, ACLS & PALS certifications
Background Check and Live Scan
Employment Misconduct
Legal Right to Work in the United States
Vaccination Policies
Smoking and Tobacco Policy
Drug Free Environment
California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act
E-Verify
Pre-Placement Health Evaluation
All external candidates must have a Bachelor of Science in Nursing
Minimum of 4 years recent clinical nursing experience in adult acute care, (within the last two years)
Demonstrated supervisory experience working in an acute care setting

The House Supervisor is responsible for all administrative management functions related to patient placement, the delivery of patient care and throughput functions, as well as the quality of nursing practice and the standards of care, throughout the Medical Center during off hours, weekends & holidays. The supervisor will direct the SPPO staff and provide support to the various hospital units throughout the Medical Center while maintaining clinical nursing practice skills and unit specific expertise. Specific duties include managing staff, directing patient care activities, monitoring & facilitating bed placement, providing clinical support to various acute care units, and participating on performance improvement projects. Serves as a role model and clinical resource to colleagues, staff, patients and others.
Strong customer service orientation as well as written and oral communication skills
Knowledge of JCAHO and other regulatory requirements present in an acute care setting
Complete understanding of acuity levels for all patient populations
Ability to work variable shifts including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays
